resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]String Operations[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Strings can be added together (also called [b]concatenation[/b]):
[code format="py" codeId="286"]print("Spam" + 'eggs')[/code] 
Strings can also be [b]multiplied[/b] by integers. This produces a repeated version of the original string. [code format="py" codeId="287"]print("spam" * 3)

print(4 * '2')[/code]
[note]Strings can't be multiplied by other strings. Strings also can't be multiplied by floats, even if the floats are whole numbers.[/note]

resolved.title: 字符串操作
resolved.problem_statement_md:
让我们来测试一下你的编码水平:

输入一个字符串，在新的一行中输出该字符串的每个字母，并重复**N**次，其中**N**是该字母在字符串中的位置。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]String Operations[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Let's test your coding skills!
Take a string as input and output each letter of the string on a new line, repeated [b]N[/b] times, where [b]N[/b] is the position of the letter in the string.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
data

[b]Sample Output: [/b]
d
aa
ttt
aaaa 

[note][b]Hint[/b]: Use a loop to iterate over the string, keeping the position number of the current iteration in a variable. Then use multiplication to repeat the letters.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 用一个循环来迭代字符串，在一个变量中保留当前迭代的位置号。然后使用乘法来重复这些字母。

code_templates.solution_code:
word = input()
i=0
while(i<len(word)):
  print(word[i]*(i+1))
  i+=1

testcases.expected_output:
a
ww
eee
ssss
ooooo
mmmmmm
eeeeeee
